Rahul Mishra
Business Development & Sales Professional | Remote (India)
rahul.mishra566@example.com | +91 9583598865

Summary
Results-driven business development professional focused on B2B Sales and account growth in technology and consumer services. Strong track record generating qualified leads, managing key accounts, and closing deals through consultative selling and data-driven outreach. Comfortable working remotely with cross-functional teams and CRM-driven workflows.

Experience

Swiggy — Feb 2025 - Present
Business Development Manager | Remote
- Drove B2B Sales efforts targeting SMB and mid-market restaurant accounts, onboarding 120+ merchant partners in 6 months and increasing segment GMV by 18% quarter-over-quarter using targeted outreach.
- Led Lead Generation campaigns combining email sequences and Salesforce-driven lists, improving conversion from MQL to SQL by 34% and reducing average sales cycle from 28 to 19 days.
- Managed renewal and upsell conversations with 45+ existing partners, leveraging Key Account Management practices to lift average monthly revenue per account by 22%.
- Coordinated with operations and marketing under Agile cadences to launch two localized partnership pilots, resulting in a 12% uptick in activation rates.

Finlytics — Dec 2024 - Jan 2025
Sales Manager | Remote
- Executed B2B Sales playbook for fintech analytics product, closing 6 pilot deals within the first month and contributing to a 15% increase in pipeline value.
- Established Key Account Management routines for top 10 prospects, creating tailored onboarding plans tracked in Salesforce and achieving a 90% demo-to-pilot engagement rate.
- Built focused Lead Generation funnels using cold outreach and referrals, generating 180 qualified leads in four weeks and prioritizing high-intent targets.
- Collaborated with product and engineering in Agile sprints to translate client feedback into two prioritized feature requests, accelerating time-to-value for customers.

Cognizant — May 2024 - Nov 2024
Business Development Manager | Remote
- Led B2B Sales initiatives for digital transformation services, securing contracts with three enterprise clients worth $420K ARR through solution-led proposals.
- Owned Lead Generation strategy across industry verticals, leveraging Salesforce for segmentation and reporting; increased SALs by 40% in one quarter.
- Provided Key Account Management for strategic customers, implementing quarterly business reviews and SLA tracking that improved retention signals and expanded scope of work by 27%.
- Partnered with delivery and engineering teams using Agile ceremonies to align proposals with implementation feasibility, reducing scope revisions by 30%.

Projects
- CRM Optimization (personal initiative): Implemented customized Salesforce reporting and lead-scoring rules for a freelance client, improving lead prioritization and increasing close rate by 18%.
- Open-source contributor: Small automation scripts on Linux to streamline data exports and Git-based versioning for sales collateral; reduced manual report prep time by ~25%.

Tools: Salesforce
Sales: B2B Sales, Lead Generation, Key Account Management

BBA, Christ University
